title: A clock that kept another place’s time
titleZh: 一只保留另一個地方時間的鐘
passage:
A clock that kept another place’s time
From the teaching blog of the fictional Alder Maritime Museum

A clock on a ship could be useful precisely because it did not show the ship’s local time. By comparing the local time aboard ship with the time at a place whose longitude was known, navigators could work out their east–west position. Both readings had to describe the same moment. At our learning station, one display represents the reference place. A second display shows the ship’s local time. Pressing the blue button records both readings at once; the silver button instead makes both displays show the ship’s local time. The silver button is for resetting the demonstration after an activity.

Our inspiration is John Harrison’s marine timekeeper H4, which he completed in 1759. Its appearance is closer to a large pocket watch than to the earlier, much larger H3. The watch-shaped object visitors may lift and turn over here is a nonworking copy used to show the size and shape of H4. The enclosed working model beside it is not a copy of H4’s shape or mechanism; it is a teaching device that drives the two displays. Neither object is the original H4.

H4 performed well during its sea trials. That did not immediately establish that other makers could build similarly accurate instruments. The Board of Longitude considered those two questions separately in deciding how Harrison should be rewarded. A section of our exhibit is called “One Good Watch Isn’t a Fleet.” Visitors there draw two activity cards: one follows a watch on a voyage; the other follows a second maker at a workbench. The guide asks what kind of evidence each card could provide.
passageZh:
一只保留另一個地方時間的鐘
本文來自虛構的奧爾德海事博物館教學部落格

船上的鐘之所以有用，有時正因為它顯示的不是船所在位置的當地時間。航海人員把船上的當地時間和一個已知經度地點的時間相比，就能算出自己在東西方向的位置。兩個讀數必須是同一時刻的時間。館內學習區的一個顯示器代表參考地點，另一個顯示器則顯示船上的當地時間。按下藍色按鈕可同時記錄兩個讀數；按銀色按鈕則會讓兩個顯示器都顯示船上的當地時間。銀色按鈕用於活動結束後重設示範裝置。

本展的靈感來自約翰・哈里森於 1759 年完成的 H4 航海時計。和早期大上許多的 H3 相比，H4 的外型更接近一只大型懷錶。這裡讓參觀者可以拿起來翻看的懷錶造型展品，是用來呈現 H4 尺寸與外型的非運作複製品。旁邊罩在展示箱內的運作模型，並未仿造 H4 的外型或機構；它是帶動兩個顯示器的教學裝置。這兩件都不是 H4 原件。

H4 在海上測試中表現良好，但這並沒有立刻證明其他製作者也能造出同等準確的儀器。經度委員會在評估應如何獎勵哈里森時，將這兩件事分開考量。本展有一區叫作「一只好錶，還不是一支船隊」。參觀者會抽兩張活動卡：一張跟著一只錶出海，另一張跟著第二位製作者在工作臺前動手。導覽員會請大家想想兩張卡各可提供什麼樣的證據。
